"Create a complete, playable 2D top-down survival action roguelike game inspired by Vampire Survivors.

The game should feature the following systems:

1. Player Character

- The player controls a hero using WASD or arrow keys.
- Smooth 360-degree movement.
- The character attacks nearby enemies automatically.
- The player has health, movement speed, attack power, and defense stats.

2. Enemy System

- Enemies continuously spawn from all directions.
- Enemies automatically chase the player.
- Different enemy types with unique movement speeds, health, and abilities.
- Enemy waves become increasingly difficult over time.
- Powerful boss enemies appear every 5 minutes.

3. Weapons and Combat

- Automatically attack enemies with equipped weapons.
- Include swords, magic projectiles, fireballs, lightning, spinning blades, and area-of-effect attacks.
- Weapons can be upgraded to increase damage, attack speed, projectile count, and attack range.
- Add satisfying hit effects, damage numbers, and enemy death animations.

4. Leveling and Upgrades

- Defeated enemies drop experience gems.
- Collect experience gems to level up.
- When leveling up, pause the game and display three random upgrade choices.
- Players can choose new weapons, upgrade existing weapons, or improve character stats.
- Include rare and powerful weapon evolutions.

5. Survival Gameplay

- The objective is to survive for 30 minutes.
- Display a survival timer, health bar, experience bar, level, and kill counter.
- Increase enemy spawn rates and difficulty as time passes.
- Add collectible health items and temporary power-ups.

6. Graphics and Visual Style

- Beautiful 2D pixel-art graphics.
- Dark fantasy atmosphere with forests, graveyards, ruins, and mysterious environments.
- Smooth character animations.
- Colorful magical attacks and impressive visual effects.
- A polished and modern game interface.

7. Game Features

- Main menu with Start Game, Settings, and Restart options.
- Game Over and Victory screens.
- Multiple playable characters with unique abilities.
- Randomized upgrades for high replayability.
- Sound effects and background music.
- Smooth performance even with hundreds of enemies on screen.

8. Important Requirements

- Make the game fully playable, not just a visual demonstration.
- Implement real enemy AI, collision detection, damage calculations, and progression systems.
- Make the gameplay addictive, challenging, and satisfying.
- Use original characters, enemies, weapons, and visual assets.
- Create a complete working game with responsive controls and minimal bugs.

Start by building a playable prototype with player movement, automatic attacks, enemy spawning, experience collection, and level-up upgrades. Then expand it into a polished survival roguelike game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
